title: meivan Scalable API-as-a-Service Platform (Saas Product)
description: Meivan is a scalable API-as-a-Service platform that enables developers to create, manage, and deploy APIs effortlessly. With features like automated documentation, analytics, and seamless integration, Meivan empowers businesses to build robust APIs and accelerate their development process.

title: AI Civilization Simulator — Multi-Agent AI Simulation
description: AI Civilization Simulator is a multi-agent simulation project where autonomous AI agents gather resources, craft items, build settlements, manage infrastructure, and make decisions in a dynamic procedurally generated world. The project explores reinforcement learning, multi-agent systems, resource management, spatial planning, and emergent civilization behavior.

title: AI Research Assistant- Research Paper Question Answering System
description: An agentic AI application that searches and filters high-quality arXiv research papers, downloads and indexes PDFs into a vector database, and answers user questions using a ReAct-based RAG pipeline with FastAPI and Streamlit.

title: GridAlchemy - Instagram Post photo grid with image enhancer
description: GridAlchemy is a simple tool that transforms a wide banner into multiple Instagram-ready posts. It slices the banner into perfectly sized 1080×1350 tiles, making it easy to upload and create a seamless grid on Instagram.

title: Market Intelligence Agent- AI Powered Market Research Tool
description: Market Intelligence Agent Tool is an AI-driven solution that collects and analyzes real-time market data from multiple sources. It provides key insights on trends, competitors, and customer sentiment using NLP and LLMs. Users can query insights via a chat interface and visualize them on an interactive dashboard.

title: Deep-Fake Face Detection on Video by using MTCNN and GRU Hybrid approach
description: Developed a hybrid deep learning model combining MTCNN for accurate face detection and GRU for sequence-based deepfake classification on video frames. Leveraged PyTorch and OpenCV to process datasets like DFDC and Celeb-DF. Achieved reliable results in detecting fake faces by analyzing temporal and spatial patterns.

title: AI-Based India Trip Planner with Itinerary Suggestions
description: An intelligent travel planning tool that suggests budget-friendly itineraries, tourist spots, cafes, and hotels based on your preferences. Get day-by-day plans, story ideas, and music prompts using AI and LLMs by fine-tuning a GPT-3.5 model.

title: VGG-16 Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) Architecture Fine-Tuning Techniques
description: An in-depth look at the VGG-16 architecture, a popular convolutional neural network model. This project covers the structure, layers, and fine-tuning techniques used to enhance the performance of VGG-16 for various image classification tasks.

title: Calculation of Karl Pearson's Coefficient of Correlation from Scratch
description: Calculating Karl Pearson's Coefficient of Correlation from scratch. Understanding the step-by-step process enhances comprehension of the statistical concepts involved in measuring the strength and direction of linear relationships between variables.
